description: Postgame town NPCs and tournament reactions, part one.

english: I heard you were amazing at the DigiColosseum. Legend Master? A living legend already?! Isn't that a bit early at your age? Anyway, well done! That's our Taiki! Someday, let's have a serious match, you and me!
